BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; 50TH ANNIVERSARY OF VIETNAM WAR AND SOUTHEAST ASIAN CONFLICT. +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for commemorative program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; 50TH ANNIVERSARY OF VIETNAM WAR AND SOUTHEAST ASIAN CONFLICT.

$150,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for the joint commemoration program for the 50th anniversary of the Vietnam War/Secret War in Laos/Southeast Asian Conflict, as provided in Laws 2024, chapter 106, article 4, section 2, subdivision 5, paragraph (k).
